authority: House topology contract for physical navigation reconciliation
status: DESIGN/RECONCILIATION CONTRACT — NOT PHYSICAL ROUTE PROOF
principle: House identity, role ownership, logical destination, and physical connectivity are separate authorities.

topology.model: House 1 is the only inter-house transit hub.
topology.route_rule: A journey between House 2 and House 3, when logically authorized, must return through House 1; no direct House 2↔House 3 physical route may be authored.

logical_vs_physical.logical_authority: Application routes and role/access contracts define user intent and authorization.
logical_vs_physical.physical_authority: Canonical SH3D and validated portal/route evidence define actual traversability.
logical_vs_physical.important: Logical access between destinations does not imply a direct physical connection between their houses.

validation_requirements: Prove a physical portal from House 1 into House 2 before enabling House 1↔House 2 physical travel.
Prove a physical portal from House 1 into House 3 before enabling House 1↔House 3 physical travel.
Never create a House 2↔House 3 portal solely because both houses have logical destinations.
For any House 2↔House 3 logical journey, resolve it as House 2→House 1→House 3 or House 3→House 1→House 2 once each physical leg is proven.
Keep role authorization independent from spatial routing.

current_evidence.House 1: canonical physical structure exists; exterior transfer remains candidate-only
current_evidence.House 2: candidate geometry exists in noncanonical staging; transfer to House 1 unproven
current_evidence.House 3: candidate geometry exists in noncanonical staging; transfer to House 1 unproven
current_evidence.House 2↔House 3: no significant/proven physical connection; direct connection prohibited by this topology contract

role_transition.house_3_to_house_2: must_return_via_house_1; seeker/owner session does not gain broker capabilities
